plain owing control.scope: A different fresh count is possible only on a taking offshoot with owing at most one. These saved readings need not reveal every intermediate birth.

renamings.note: The records store per-pair courses only for pairs with a meeting. A differing course is saved at its first difference. The renamings ran no knot tests.

scope: Counts are ordered pair readings. Reverse order, knot laws and numberings can repeat one mechanism. Course graphs are reclassified exactly. Per-knot ancestral classifications, proper subsets' course class numbers, first differing-entry records, and knot-test counts are read as stored. The per-subset raw courses, complete value histories, tested knot relations, and symmetry maps are absent from the pair rows.

supplemental symmetry.scope: Supplement covers only the four usual rings and the extra ring, both knot laws, the waiting and uncapped owing laws. It fixes each start knot. Individual start distinctions were not specified as fixed.
